issue-9471.title: Node 52 shows as battery-powered after replacing the stick
issue-9471.author: c0coco
issue-9471.story: After moving to a new Acme hub, node 52 reports as battery-powered and asleep. The driver log shows the controller answering GetNodeProtocolInfo for node 52 with all zeros.
issue-9471.state: The reporter offered to send a fix and asked where the check belongs.

findings.text: The controller answered GetNodeProtocolInfo with all zeros for node 52. The driver should detect this response and warn that the stored node data looks corrupted.
The reporter runs driver 15.3.0, two releases behind. The NVM restore fix landed in 15.4.0.

routes.title: Reply: a PR is welcome
routes.why: He already found the cause and only asked where the check belongs.
routes.text: Thanks for digging into this! A PR is welcome. The check belongs in `Controller.getNodeProtocolInfo()`, right after the response is parsed.

routes.title: Start fix: warn on empty protocol info
Move to widgets-desktop
routes.why: The second half of the report is about the UI's network graph.
routes.text: Thanks for the report! The graph part of this looks like a Widgets Desktop problem. Please open a new issue in acme/widgets-desktop with your UI version and a screenshot of the network graph.

issue-9472.state: Without a debug log we cannot tell whether the node or the driver stops.

routes.title: Ask: driver log on debug
routes.text:
Please make a driver log, loglevel `debug` and attach it here as a file. Cover at least one hour, so it includes the moment the sensor goes quiet.

You can find instructions here: https://widgets.github.io/widgets/#/troubleshooting/connectivity-issues

routes.text: Thanks for the report. This is the same problem as #9312, so I'm closing this one. Please follow that issue for updates.

params.title: Wakeup interval resets to the default after a re-interview

routes.text:
A re-interview of the ZW100 sets the wakeup interval back to 3600 seconds.
The driver should restore the interval the user configured before.

routes.title: File issue: document the reset
routes.text:
The docs for `restoreNVM` do not mention the soft reset afterwards.
Apps should wait for the driver ready event again.
